WITH equip_data AS (
  SELECT 
    e."EQUIP_CODE",
    e."EquipType",
    CAST(e."RELIAB_IDX" AS numeric) as reliability_idx,
    CAST(et.type_indices->>'performance_score' AS numeric) as perf_score,
    CAST(et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx' AS numeric) as env_impact,
    om."OPER_hours",
    om."maintCycleHrs",
    om."OPER_status"
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType"
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = om."equipRef"
),
eer_calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    (perf_score + reliability_idx) / 2.0 * (1.0 - env_impact / 100.0) as EER
  FROM equip_data
),
ors_calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN "OPER_status" = 'Active' THEN 10.0 * (1.0 - "OPER_hours" / "maintCycleHrs")
      WHEN "OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5.0 * (1.0 - "OPER_hours" / "maintCycleHrs")
      ELSE 0
    END as ORS
  FROM eer_calc
),
loss_calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    0.5 * EER + 0.5 * ORS * (1.0 - "OPER_hours" / 20000.0) as LOSS
  FROM ors_calc
)
SELECT "EQUIP_CODE", "EquipType", ROUND(CAST(LOSS AS numeric), 4) as LOSS
FROM loss_calc
ORDER BY "EquipType", LOSS DESC
LIMIT 10;
